notes.title: 《恐惧之影》第二季小型热更新
notes.content:

[h2]一、BUG修复[/h2]

[h3]1，修复了新手教程《49号工厂》击杀僵尸导致进度卡住的问题；

notes.title: 《恐惧之影》第二季重大更新！
notes.content:
好久不见！
[b][h2]《恐惧之影》第二季版本重大更新已上线！[/h2][/b]

具体更新内容如下：

[b][h3]一、《死寂》联动活动[/h3][/b]

《恐惧之影》与《死寂》游戏联动。

在活动奖励中，有两个专属的武器[b]动态迷彩[/b]“蓝色斑马”与“紫气东来”

[b][h2]蓝色斑马[/h2][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710422/d6f85cbeae9fca70863bb11b79b3653c5e97a0c8.png[/img]


[b][h2]紫气东来[/h2][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710422/dca6e03236ae90637a8d8d47032e1747d3b0f96f.png[/img]

新增新模式《死寂突围》
新增一张《死寂》迷雾地图世界观下的新地图《幸存者营地》

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710422/fd9429ef0ff7e98857a3b78da72a9f8d352d64e5.png[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710422/97de9bcf287e29d11c7ff2d48a96f599ecbe4ab1.png[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710422/4dbda73e3b8c4d535829f59f67bbf4b6716253a2.png[/img]

为了让更多新手玩家了解游戏的操作机制
这次更新专门增加了新手教学，围绕着游戏核心的运行机制

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710422/224867e2e5d18fd69109155238eecb4f2c871dd6.png[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710422/8b6c350ea462318649c4fa5c3b27b2e06a3369c1.png[/img]

[b][h3]三、重做了武器迷彩界面[/h3][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710422/3946ce62740de952582ffaa5d8c5dda79ab6e82d.png[/img]


[b][h3]四，新增武器四大大师迷彩挑战[/h3][/b]
均为[b]动态迷彩[/b]

[b][h2]黑金[/h2][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710422/ba0593639a3f50f8d8832ac3674f5581e7d4c3d1.png[/img]

[b][h2]科技[/h2][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710422/d201f6f441aa74dcb247a811754db69bdee5c42a.png[/img]

[b][h2]蛛网[/h2][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710422/228318018d77997f3bcb6dc8d19fdee38cdf630e.png[/img]

[b][h2]星空[/h2][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710422/12dfcc4808a40f67798ee6a0407c5a7df185608a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710422/0cea96f3d730f035dee959a413a64234f19ea112.gif[/img]

1，极大程度上优化了切枪系统，现在玩家可以无缝切枪并且切枪可以打断，不会出现卡模型以及其他bug

3，优化了武器瞄准系统，现在武器的瞄准点更加准确

感谢大家对《恐惧之影》的支持
你们是游戏更新唯一的动力！

notes.title: Shadow of Fear Season 2 Regular Update
notes.content:
《恐惧之影》第二季
经过大部分网友粉丝的建议与反馈
决定优化以下内容：

2，解决了切枪卡顿严重的问题；

3，解决了切枪武器模型出乱的问题；

[h3]三，游戏机制方面[/h3]

[h3]1，现在玩家跑步状态下购买物品不会强制降低速度；

2，现在玩家跑步时瞄准结束不会卡视野；

[b]感谢各大网友粉丝们的反馈！
《恐惧之影》再接再厉！[/b]

notes.title: Shadow of Fear Season 2 is coming with shock!
notes.content:
Shadow of Fear Season 2 Major Update!
(This update has optimized a lot of content, so only this update has been decided to be deleted.)

[h1][b]Game Content[/b][/h1]

[h2]New Map[/h2]

[h3][b]The Classic Survival Mode “Ahkok”[/b][/h3]
After escaping from the duel arena, we were transported to the Ahkok subway station and our communication with the command center was completely cut off. From now on, we can only rely on ourselves
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710422/cd3a2ed7f0bd4295b48c613c91b9ddc228939aa8.png[/img]


[h3][b]Charge Forward Mode "Atlas"[/b][/h3]
The fireball of the Evil Spirit Freight Yard incident led us to the Atlas International Airport in the eastern United States. The former glory is now on the brink of death. What kind of secret is there here?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710422/f51213706fbfa05724923d436d411ec048231f61.png[/img]


[h2]Reinforcing properties [/h2]
Four different enhancement items have been added to the game
Max Ammo；
Insta-Kill；
Bonus Point；
Double Point
Kill zombies in the game and randomly drop them

[h2]Double experience token[/h2]
We can see the double experience button in the bottom right corner of the main page. Upgrading the character level can earn more tokens. This update will send out two tokens for each player
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710422/af01bb77b6877a9bd94375d360700d241d3ba153.png[/img]



[h1][b]Safe House[/b][/h1]

[h2]一，Add player level mechanism[/h2]
The higher the level, the richer the reward. Most of the rewards in the game are tied to the character's level
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710422/89a91cb7a30f6f6801c61339d8d4de3d4499b773.png[/img]


[h2]二，武器迷彩[/h2]
新增武器迷彩机制，玩家们在游戏中完成对应的挑战内容即可解锁武器迷彩，每一把武器的挑战各不相同
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710422/60c2cb774911c38b5ae5bb8079cb623587a93ba0.jpg[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710422/ef67667bcae574963d4fc8530c2a6b5d3c7b2d7a.jpg[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710422/7c979a67ec736eee2ca6d006a0bdc9db160926aa.jpg[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710422/7efccd13d70c4291ae46a812df11c5b12b4911ef.jpg[/img]


[h2]Equipment upgrade mechanism update[/h2]
The weapon level in the game has been increased from level 5 to level 15; Character level increased from level 5 to level 10

[h2]Glove replacement[/h2]
Now more gloves have been added for players to unlock and use. The gloves are bound to a certain level and can be used by completing the corresponding challenge after reaching a certain level!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710422/774023c75f258201a439e27b6a2a0d4cb417dd8a.png[/img]


[h1][b]Game optimization[/b][/h1]

[h2]Game performance optimization[/h2]
Now the game has been modified with textures and lighting, and overall performance is expected to improve by 10-15 frames

[h2]Received damage notification[/h2]
Now the game has added a screen prompt for receiving damage, which can indicate the direction of zombie attacks on players；

[h2]Sound optimization[/h2]
The overall sound effect of the game is optimized. When the player's health drops below a certain level, there will be a heart beating sound and all surrounding music will decrease synchronously

[h2]Game capacity optimization[/h2]
Now the game has been reduced from 22g to 7g, greatly reducing the capacity burden on players

notes.title: Technology breakthrough in Shadow of Fear! Infinite Wave Zombie Tide!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Infinite Zombie Tide[/b][/h1]

In the process of optimizing and updating in the season2,
Shadow of Fear has now achieved infinite wave zombie tide technology

In the classic survival mode, you can only play up to 42 waves and the game will end
And now, as the wave frequency continues to increase, zombies will also become stronger and stronger
[u][b]Infinite Zombie Tide[/b][/u]，Fight until death

[h1][b]Reinforcing properties [/b][/h1]
In the season2, enhanced items were added, and killing zombies has a random probability of gaining:

[h3][b]MAX AMMO[/b][/h3]

[h3][b]INSTA-KILL[/b][/h3]

[h3][b]BONUS POINT[/b][/h3]

[h3][b]DOUBLE POINT[/b][/h3]

And as the wave number increases, the probability decreases;

[h1][b]Double experience token mechanism[/b][/h1]

After receiving feedback and suggestions from many players,
Shadow of Fear Season 2 will add the "Double Experience Token" feature

[h3][b]“Double character experience token”[/b][/h3]

[h3][b]“Double Zombie Point Token”[/b][/h3]

As the level increases, you will receive more tokens and rewards;

The second season of "Shadow of Fear" will be available soon,
Thank you for your feedback and support!

The game will also improve under everyone's feedback and supervision!

notes.title: The free DLC for the second season of Shadow of Fear is coming soon!
notes.content:
In the free DLC of the second season of Shadow of Fear, you will experience the following content:
1、 Game Map
DLC will update and add three new classic survival maps in batches;
1. Ahkok - Russia
2 "Kowloon Fortress" - Hong Kong, China
3 "Silent Land" - Japan

And a map of charging into battle;
Atlas - USA

2、 Weapon camouflage and gloves
In this DLC, players will unlock four types of camouflage by completing tasks;
"Desert Gold"
"Rose Platinum"
"Flowing light and black radiance"
"Scarlet ether"

And add a large number of glove models, which also require completing tasks to unlock

3、 Player level
In this DLC, player levels will be added, and players only need to kill zombies in the game to gain experience points;
(Note: Player level is bound to some gloves. Automatically unlocked upon reaching level)

4、 Game main page
The main page of this DLC game will be completely renovated, so everyone can look forward to it first!

The second season of DLC will be launched soon. Thank you for your continuous support and encouragement
Stay tuned!

notes.title: The first free DLC of Shadow of Fear
notes.content:
The first free DLC of Shadow of Fear has now been launched!
1、 New mode
The charging mode has now been added to Shadow of Fear!
There is no need to decrypt here, the start is a one hit kill buff! Kill zombies directly!
Completing the "Charge Forward" mode can earn more reward content!
2、 New Map
The complete map of "Dueling Ground" has now been officially launched!
New plot and new puzzles await everyone!
Every three rounds, there will also be special levels where the classic "ammunition full" buff will appear after killing!
3、 New weapons
The AG14W assault rifle is now officially added to the game!
4、 Safe House System
1. A new hand model replacement system has been added to the safe room, allowing players to unlock different hand models through in-game tasks!
2. The upgrade interface of the safe house has been greatly improved, and the current page is even cooler!
Everyone, hurry up and experience the game! Thank you all for your support!
If there are any problems during the gameplay, please provide timely feedback!
